findings.title: No committed Supabase-generated TypeScript types; client is untyped
findings.evidence: src/infrastructure/supabase/client.ts builds `createClient(...)` without a `Database` generic; repository results are read as `any` (no `.returns<T>()`/`.cast<T>()` anywhere in src/). No `Database` type is committed under src/ or a types module.
findings.remediation: Generate and commit `supabase gen types` output and thread the `Database` generic through the client and repositories.

findings.title: Non-idempotent migration: 20260628000012_customer_experience_forecasting_accounting_advanced.sql
findings.remediation: Prepend `DROP POLICY IF EXISTS <name> ON <table>;` before the CREATE POLICY so the migration can be re-applied cleanly.

findings.remediation: Prepend `DROP POLICY IF EXISTS <name> ON <table>;` before the CREATE POLICY so the migration can be re-applied cleanly.

findings.title: Foreign key marked NOT VALID: payments.payments_invoice_center_fk
findings.evidence: FOREIGN KEY (invoice_id, center_id) REFERENCES invoices(id, center_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT VALID
findings.remediation: Validate the constraint (`ALTER TABLE ... VALIDATE CONSTRAINT ...`) after confirming no orphaned rows; a NOT VALID FK does not protect pre-existing rows.

findings.title: Foreign key marked NOT VALID: services.services_category_fk
findings.evidence: FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES service_categories(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT VALID
findings.remediation: Validate the constraint (`ALTER TABLE ... VALIDATE CONSTRAINT ...`) after confirming no orphaned rows; a NOT VALID FK does not protect pre-existing rows.

findings.title: Duplicate foreign key pair: payments -> invoices
findings.evidence: Two FKs reference the same target: FOREIGN KEY (invoice_id, center_id) REFERENCES invoices(id, center_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT VALID AND FOREIGN KEY (invoice_id) REFERENCES invoices(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
findings.remediation: Keep the intended FK and drop the redundant one (a composite NOT VALID FK and a simple FK on the same column are usually the legacy + the fix).

findings.title: btree_gist exclusion constraint is canonical-only (replay surrogate)
findings.evidence: appointments_no_scheduled_staff_overlap EXCLUDE requires btree_gist gist `=` opclass, unavailable in PGlite.
findings.remediation: No code change. Constraint exists in canonical migration and applies in Supabase; PGlite replay records it as canonical-only.
